apps.title: Air Attack
apps.description: Shoot through a retro arcade game with original artwork and Scratch-derived sounds.
apps.requirements: Aroma for the WUHB. Wii U GamePad controls. No separately purchased game data is required.
apps.install: Extract the complete SD package and launch AirAttack.wuhb from the Wii U Menu.
apps.author: Martin Butler
apps.sourceDetails: This is based on a Scratch game that I wrote during the Pandemic. The background image and the sounds have been borrowed from Scratch, the rest of the images were drawn using tools in Scratch.\n\nThe game uses the overall framework and sound code from PacMan-ish, it also extends the draw code.

apps.title: Blockamok Remix
apps.description: Dodge an endless field of 3D blocks, with difficulty, visual and music options.
apps.requirements: Use the packaged WUHB with Aroma where present. The RPX is the separate launcher build. Keep all supplied resources.
apps.install: Extract the complete ZIP to the SD root and preserve the supplied app folder and resources.
apps.author: Mode8fx
apps.sourceDetails: Fly through a 3D world of never-ending blocks and survive for as long as you can! Includes customization options for both gameplay and visuals, along with five music tracks.

apps.title: Button Break
apps.description: Test the Wii U GamePad buttons in a simple score-based game.
apps.requirements: The author requires the Aroma environment and a Wii U GamePad.
apps.install: Place the supplied homebrew file under sd:/wiiu/apps/ by extracting its full SD bundle.
apps.author: Nightkingale
apps.sourceDetails:
Button Break is a very simple game made in order to test basic functionality of the Wii U GamePad controller. This was a project that's been held back from release for over a year because of its simplicity, but is finally being released because of the ever-growing homebrew scene.

Installation:

A Wii U homebrew file will be bundled with each release. It should be placed on your SD card, particularly in wiiu/apps/.

It's important to have the Aroma environment installed for Button Break to work. Please visit our hacking guide and the Aroma webpage if you would like to softmod your Wii U console.

Credits:

I hope that I am able to express my thanks as much as possible to those who made this repository possible.

QuarkTheAwesome, for writing the ProgrammingOnTheU tutorials that inspired me to make Button Break.

apps.title: Labyrinth
apps.description: Find the exit in a sequence of randomly generated retro mazes.
apps.requirements: Aroma for the Wii U WUHB; no external game assets required.
apps.install: Extract the package preserving wiiu/apps/Labyrinth/ and launch its WUHB.
apps.author: Martin Butler
apps.sourceDetails:
A game where the player has to find their way out of a maze, to get to the next level.

I had wanted to do a maze game for many years. I did a version in Scratch during the pandemic, but this only had one fixed maze. I've re-written the game for Wii U, as I wanted to develop an algorithm for generating random mazes.

The game is deliberately very retro, but I hope you like it.

apps.title: Othello
apps.description: Play the disc-flipping board game against the computer, with selectable difficulty.
apps.requirements: A homebrew-enabled Wii U; use the bundled WUHB on Aroma. No external game data required.
apps.install: Extract the complete SD bundle and launch the Othello app from the Wii U Menu.
apps.author: Martin Butler
apps.sourceDetails:
This is a Wii U Homebrew version of the Othello game.

The player plays against the computer, alternating who plays first. The aim is to surround and flip the opponents pieces to your colour; the one with the most at the end is the winner.

Th full Rules and Instructions for the game can be found here:
https://www.mastersofgames.com/rules/reversi-othello-rules.htm

Hope you like it.

apps.title: Tank Trap
apps.description: Drive a drilling tank through destructible terrain in sandbox or network battles.
apps.requirements: Aroma for the WUHB. Sandbox works solo; online multiplayer depends on the project service and network.
apps.install: Keep the complete supplied package at its SD paths. Launch sand.wuhb; left stick moves, right stick aims, A drills and B uses an item.
apps.author: Crementif
apps.sourceDetails:
Tank Trap is a fully original Wii U homebrew game made in a game jam as a Wii U tech demo. You control a drill tank in a fully destructable, dynamic multiplayer arena, inspired by games like Noita.

Drill through sand and lava, find items to destroy opponents, and watch as the landscape changes with each item used. Create traps and obstacles for your opponents to fall into, or use the terrain to burn your enemies in all the chaos.

A sandbox mode is also available for solo play.

## Features
Play solo in Sandbox Mode
Battle up to 4+ players online
Fully multiplayer physics simulation
Random item pickups for terrain manipulation
Interactive title screen to play around with the physics and materials
Dynamic shader effects (made possible with CafeGLSL)

How To Play
Use the left stick to move your tank
Use the right stick to aim your drill
Press A to drill/jump
Press B to use your item

Secret cheat: In sandbox mode, press Select to open the debug mode where you can use infinite items!

apps.title: COLD START
apps.description: Survive a top-down roguelike with bombs, upgrades and custom maps.
apps.requirements: This is the Wii U WUHB build, not the Switch NRO or Android APK. Network/workshop features depend on external services.
apps.install: Extract the complete Wii U SD package. Keep bundled game resources; launch the WUHB from the Wii U Menu with Aroma.
apps.author: etonedemid
apps.sourceDetails: COLD START is a roguelike topdown survival with bombs, upgrades, parrying and a console where you can spawn a car and run enemies over. Runs on PC, Nintendo Switch and Wii U homebrew, and Android.
apps.versionNote: The source labels this package 3.6.0, but its preserved executable filename is cold_start-wiiu-3.3.0.wuhb. The executable version has not been independently established.

apps.title: Crispy Doom U
apps.description: Play Doom through the Aroma-specific Crispy Doom U port.
apps.requirements: Aroma-compatible port. Supply your own legally obtained Doom IWAD; commercial game data is not included.
apps.install: Extract the package, then use sd:/wiiu/apps/crispy-doom-u/ as the hardcoded application directory and put your own IWAD/PWAD files in its wads/ subfolder. Keep the supplied app resources.
apps.author: thearst3rd, strejf
apps.sourceDetails: A Crispy Doom Port for the Wii U, Crispy Doom is a friendly fork of Chocolate Doom that provides a higher display resolution, removes the static limits of the Doom engine and offers further optional visual, tactical and physical enhancements while remaining entirely config file, savegame, netplay and demo compatible with the original.

apps.title: EasyRPG
apps.description: Run supported RPG Maker 2000, RPG Maker 2003 and EasyRPG games.
apps.requirements: Aroma for the WUHB. Supply a complete compatible game folder; some games also require their licensed RTP assets. No commercial games or RTP are bundled.
apps.install: Extract the full SD bundle. Put each complete game folder alongside the WUHB in sd:/wiiu/apps/EasyRPG/, keeping RPG_RT.ldb and RPG_RT.lmt together. RTP may also go in /wiiu/data/easyrpg-player/rtp/2000 or /2003.
apps.author: EasyRPG Player Team
apps.sourceDetails:
EasyRPG Player is a game interpreter to play RPG Maker 2000, 2003 and EasyRPG games. It uses the LCF parser library (liblcf) to read RPG Maker game data.

EasyRPG Player is part of the EasyRPG Project. More information is available at the project website: https://easyrpg.org/

EasyRPG is a project that aims to create a free (as in freedom) cross-platform and multi-language Role Playing Game (RPG) creation tool, inspired by a commercial product called RPG Maker.

Main goals
These are our main goals:

Free as in freedom: Every component of the project will be published under a free license.

Cross-platform: We want EasyRPG to reach as many platforms as possible.

Multi-language: The more languages are supported, the better.

https://ci.easyrpg.org/view/Homebrew/job/player-wiiu/

apps.title: MegaZeux
apps.description: Create and play MegaZeux worlds using its game engine and editor.
apps.requirements: This store RPX is marked legacy. Use a compatible Tiramisu/Homebrew Launcher environment and separately obtained MegaZeux worlds.
apps.install: Extract the full SD package, including engine support files; follow the Wii U README for world locations and input.
apps.author: AliceLR
apps.sourceDetails: MegaZeux is a game creation system originally released in 1994 and still being developed today. MegaZeux builds are currently available for Windows, Mac OS, Ubuntu and Debian Linux, Rasbian, and several different consoles.\n\nhttps://www.digitalmzx.com/ visit here for games.

apps.title: CHIP8 Emulator
apps.description: Run CHIP-8 and Super CHIP-8 programs using a native GX2 interpreter.
apps.requirements: Legacy Wii U Homebrew Launcher build. Supply legally obtained CHIP-8/SCHIP programs. This is Wii U software, not a vWii DOL.

apps.sourceDetails:
A CHIP8 Emulator for WiiU.
  
  Ported by rw-r-r_0644

CHIP-8/SCHIP-8 GX2 Emulator by brienj

I updated the CHIP-8 Emulator made by rw-r-r_0644 to use GX2 graphics, include the buzzer, and support the Super CHIP-8 interpreter

apps.title: YAPE 4 U
apps.description: Emulate Commodore 264-family computers with the Wii U YAPE port.
apps.requirements: Legacy RPX/Homebrew Launcher environment. A USB keyboard is recommended. Supply your own compatible programs; use the project README for emulated-machine keys.

apps.sourceDetails:
Port of yapesdl by calmopyrin

You'll get best results with a USB keyboard and reading all the keyboard shortcuts in the Readme on GitHub.
Some functionality, such as the debug monitor, not available on Wii U yet.
Wii U version supports the gamepad, MINUS button to open/close the settings menu.

apps.title: WUDD
apps.description: Dump your Wii U discs to WUD/WUX images or installable partition files.
apps.requirements: Aroma or Tiramisu with MochaPayload Nightly-MochaPayload-20220725-155554 or newer. SD uses FAT32; its USB target requires NTFS. Use your own discs and enough free space.
apps.install: Extract its full SD package. Launch the WUHB on Aroma. Output is /wudump/[DISC-ID]/; SD images split into 2 GiB parts, so preserve every part.
apps.author: Maschell
apps.sourceDetails:
WUDD - Wii U Disc Dumper
Inspired by wudump from FIX94.

Features:

Dump a Wii U Disc in WUD (uncompressed) or WUX (loseless compression) format (including the game.key)
Dump the GM Partitions (Game, Updates, DLCs) of an Wii U Disc as .app,.h3, .tmd, .tik, .cert files
Supports dumping to SD (FAT32) and USB (NTFS only). When dumping to SD the files get slitted in 2 GiB parts.
Files will be dumped to /wudump/[DISC-ID]/. The disc id of a game can be found on the disc (e.g. WUP-P-ARDP for the EUR version of Super Mario 3D World). If WUDD fails to determine the disc id, "DISC" with a timestamp will be used instead.

How to merge splitted files

When you dump a .wux or .wud to the SD card it gets splitted into 2 GiB parts (FAT32 limitation). To merge them you can use the copy cmd tool.

Example: copy /b game.wux.part1 + game.wux.part2 game.wux

Dependencies

Requires an Environment (e.g. Tiramisu or Aroma) with MochaPayload (Nightly-MochaPayload-20220725-155554 or newer)

apps.title: Dumpling
apps.description: Dump your installed titles, discs, saves and console files for personal backups.
apps.requirements: This package includes WUHB for Aroma and a separate RPX. The author documents special SD-access restrictions when Aroma is running: reboot without Aroma (hold R at boot) and use dumpingapp.com for that SD-access route. Keep private console/account data private.
apps.install: Extract the complete package. Select the documented SD or single-partition FAT32 USB target and retain every output folder/part.
apps.author: emiyl, Crementif
apps.sourceDetails:
Dumpling is a simple Wii U file dumper, developed with the intent of making Cemu set-up faster and easier

Features
---

- Dumps files needed for Cemu online play
- Create region-free decrypted game disc dumps
- Dumps physical and digital games, updates and DLC from the system or USB storage
- Dumps game saves from the system or USB storage
- Dumps the entire decrypted nand
  - This can take over 2 hours on a 32GB Wii U

apps.title: Schism Tracker
apps.description: Compose and play tracked music in IT, XM, S3M and MOD formats.
apps.requirements: Aroma for the bundled WUHB. The author recommends a keyboard for full control. Supply your own modules and samples.
apps.install: Extract the complete SD bundle, then launch schismtracker.wuhb. Keep your music and configuration files backed up.
apps.author: Storlek
apps.sourceDetails: Schism Tracker is an editor and player for tracked music (IT, XM, S3M, MOD, etc.), heavily based on the look and feel of the DOS program Impulse Tracker.\n\nNOTE: It is recommended to use a keyboard in order to fully control the app!

apps.title: Moonlight Wii U
apps.description: Stream games from a compatible computer to the Wii U over your local network.
apps.requirements: A compatible host running Sunshine or the documented legacy GameStream service. Wii U and host must share a network; a Wii U LAN adapter is recommended. Use the packaged WUHB with Aroma; the RPX is a separate launcher variant.
apps.install: Extract the entire SD package. Set your host IP in sd:/wiiu/apps/moonlight/moonlight.conf, pair with the host and accept its pairing prompt. No PC helper is included.
apps.author: GaryOderNichts
apps.sourceDetails:
Moonlight Wii U

Moonlight Wii U is a port of Moonlight Embedded, which is an open source implementation of NVIDIA's GameStream, as used by the NVIDIA Shield.

Moonlight Wii U allows you to stream your full collection of games from your powerful Windows desktop to your Wii U.
Requirements

- GFE compatible computer with GTX 600/700/900/1000 series GPU (for the PC you're streaming from)
- Geforce Experience 2.1.1 or higher
- A Wii U LAN Adapter is recommended

If your PC isn't supported or you're having performance related issues, try using sunshine instead.
Quick Start

- Grab the latest version from the releases page and extract it to the root of your SD Card
- Enter the IP of your GFE server in the moonlight.conf file located at sd:/wiiu/apps/moonlight
- Ensure your GFE server and Wii U are on the same network
- Turn on Shield Streaming in the GFE settings
- Pair Moonlight Wii U with the GFE server
- Accept the pairing confirmation on your PC
- Connect to the GFE Server with Moonlight Wii U
- Play games!

Configuration

You can configure all of the documented settings in the moonlight.conf file located at sd:/wiiu/apps/moonlight.
Supported controllers

- Gamepad (can be disabled with the disable_gamepad option)
- Up to 4 Wii U Pro Controllers and Wii Classic Controllers (Pro)
- Gamepad needs to be disabled to use the 4th controller

apps.title: vgedit
apps.description: Edit SD-card text files with the touch screen, a controller or a USB keyboard.
apps.requirements: Use the supplied WUHB on Aroma; the RPX is a separate launcher option. Back up configuration files before editing.
apps.install: Extract the complete package. Plus saves, Minus closes, A opens the keyboard. Preserve the app folder and bundled resources.
apps.author: vgmoose
apps.sourceDetails: vgedit is a Video Game text Editor for the Wii U. It has basic file browsing functionality (SD card only) and allows text files to be edited directly using either the touch screen or a controller.\n\nPressing Plus will save the file, Minus will close it. Hitting A brings up the keyboard and B will be either delete or backspace depending on which mode you are in (when keyboard is up (insert mode), it's backspace, in the overview mode it's delete

apps.title: GamePad Auto Standby
apps.description: Turn off the GamePad screen or power after a configurable idle period.
apps.requirements: Aroma Beta-17 or newer and WiiUPluginLoaderBackend 0.3.0 or newer. This is a WPS plugin, not a standalone app.
apps.install: Extract the complete package into the SD layout. Open L + D-pad Down + Minus; default idle standby is five minutes. Disable in the plugin menu or remove its WPS from the SD card while powered off.
apps.author: Lynx64
apps.sourceDetails:
This is a Wii U plugin which makes the GamePad automatically enter standby mode (screen off) or power off when left idle for a configurable amount of time (similar to any other controller).

Additional features:
- Option to power off the GamePad on boot.
  - It will not power off if it was used to turn on the console.
- Option to keep the GamePad on while it's charging/plugged in.
- Power off/on the GamePad remotely from the plugin config menu (obviously it must be in range).

Usage:
Open the plugin config menu by pressing L, DPAD Down and Minus on the GamePad, Pro Controller or Classic Controller, or B, DPAD Down and Minus on a Wii Remote.

Default settings:
- On idle mode: Standby
- Delay: 5 minutes (lowest possible is 1 minute, highest 60)
- Power off on boot: false
- Keep on while charging: false

apps.title: Network Switcher
apps.description: Switch among configured Wii U network profiles from the Aroma plugin menu.
apps.requirements: Aroma; this 1.2 package updates WUPS for Aroma Beta26. Configure network profiles in System Settings first.
apps.install: Extract the plugin bundle. Open L + D-pad Down + Minus and choose a profile. Switching is temporary unless you explicitly change the default in the plugin.
apps.author: Daniel K. O.
apps.sourceDetails:
This is an Aroma plugin to switch between network profiles on the Wii U.

Usage:
Open the Wii U Plugin System Config Menu (press L + 🡓 + SELECT)
Enter the Network Switcher settings.
Select the network profile you want to use and press A.

Note: this change is not permanent. The Wii U will always try to use the default profile when it boots up.

You can also change which profile is the default in the plugin.

apps.title: Screenshot Unlocker
apps.description: Remove game restrictions on screenshot upload to supported browser services.
apps.requirements: Aroma; version1.1 updates WUPS for Aroma Beta26. This does not restore discontinued Miiverse or replace the Aroma Screenshot plugin.
apps.install: Extract the full plugin package into its supplied SD layout and restart Aroma. Disable the plugin or remove its WPS while powered off to undo.
apps.author: Daniel K. O.
apps.sourceDetails: Some Wii U games and apps disable the upload of screenshots to Miiverse and Web Browser. This plugin removes this restriction, to always enable screenshot uploads.\n\nNote: this plugin has no relationship to the official Screenshot plugin from Aroma.

apps.title: WiiU-Shell
apps.description: Manage SD-card files, view images, extract ZIPs and play supported audio in an NX-Shell port.
apps.requirements: Use the packaged WUHB for Aroma where present, or the documented RPX launcher variant. File deletion/moves alter your files; keep backups and work on SD content for routine use.
apps.install: Extract the complete SD package and retain the application resources. Use the matching executable for your environment; touch controls, file sorting and ZIP extraction are available.
apps.author: rw-r-r-0644
apps.sourceDetails:
Work in progress port of NX-Shell by joel16 (Multi purpose file manager) to the Nintendo WiiU.

Features:

- Delete files and folders.
- Copy/Move files and folders.
- Rename files and folders.
- Create folders.
- Displays file size. (files only ATM)
- Image viewer (PNG/JPG/GIF/BMP)
- Extract .ZIP files.
- Sorting options (Sort by name, date, size).
- Dark theme toggle.
- Audio playback. (Following formats are supported: OGG, WAV and MOD)
- Touch screen.

unavailable.title: Café-Xplorer
unavailable.description: Browse files, edit text, view images and manage SD/USB content on the console.
unavailable.requirements: Use its documented Wii U homebrew environment. Full filesystem operations can alter console files; keep backups and use SD content for routine tasks. FAT/exFAT USB behavior differs from Wii U-formatted WFS drives.
unavailable.install: Extract the complete bundle. For FAT32/exFAT USB access, connect before reboot as documented; remove the external drive and reboot to restore WFS access.
unavailable.author: SudoTronics
unavailable.sourceDetails:
A multi-purpose file manager for the Nintendo Wii U.

Features

Browse full Wii U filesystem
Navigate with D-Pad
View file information (name, size, type)
Create new files and folders
Copy and paste files/folders
Move files/folders
Rename files and folders
Delete files and folders
Side panel menu for quick access to operations

Text Editor

View and edit text files (.txt, .json, .log, .ini, .cfg, .xml, .md)
Line-by-line editing with native Wii U keyboard
Insert and delete lines
View and edit modes

Zoom in/out controls
Pan when zoomed
Reset zoom and position

Video Player

Play MP4, AVI, MKV, and MOV video files (WIP)
Playback controls (Play/Pause)
Seek forward/backward (10 seconds)
Progress bar with time display

Audio Player

Play MP3 audio files (Other codecs are planned)
Playback controls (Play/Pause)
Seek forward/backward (10 seconds)
Progress bar with time display
